description: Emails the free Briefing Kit to an address the user gives you. Call only when the user has explicitly asked to receive it by email and agreed to be emailed. Never call it on your own and never invent or guess an address. It adds the address to a mailing list and sends the kit by email.

consent.description: Must be true. Set it only if the user has explicitly asked to receive the kit by email and agreed to be emailed at this address. The user can unsubscribe from the first email.

email.description: The email address the user asked to receive the kit at.

name: email_me_the_kit
title: Email Me the Kit
